global.criterion: Clearly compact sculpted 3D cartoon educational miniature on warm off-white with credible material textures, generous margins, no photoreal broad scene or toy-face.
No baked words, numbers, arrows, labels, phone digits, printed card lines, brand-like shapes, logos, watermark or pseudo-writing.

No real or rendered person, visible helper or hand, actual injury, chemical discharge, active eye washing or treatment. Only the heat-comparison still may include visibly synthetic faceless full training mannequins.

s1-02-scene-safety-still.criterion: Empty near-side observation area is continuously divided from stationary unbadged vehicle route and a separate off-route ground hole; no tempting gap into traffic.
A protected open access route is spatially clear without drawn arrows or a person walking; vehicle is on intact ground separate from hole.
Near-orthographic top-down map composition is not the lower video hazard scan or diagonal road-case scene.

s1-02-heat-comparison-still.criterion: Two separate shade settings each have a clearly synthetic supported faceless full mannequin and unused cooling props, with a blank mock-call phone only in the urgent-warning vignette.
Both vignettes may display moisture; no visual claim that lack of sweating defines severe illness, no diagnosis from skin or pose alone.
No oral drink, treatment or visible person/helper; labels remain editable and absent from generated pixels.
Parallel overhead comparison differs in actual composition from single eye-level heat/dizzy video tableaus.

s1-02-aid-kit-still.criterion: Clean gauze, tape, blanket, sealed small starter rinse and truly blank card are separate unused tabletop props; no open kit or treatment action.
A distinct complete plumbed dual-nozzle eyewash is visible in a background alcove, not merely the small bottle.
Close near-orthographic inventory still differs from first-person open-kit video and split reasoned-choice case scene.
